sections.description: GRID-Arendal accessibility and optional editorial tools. Configure modules per website; no automatic legacy-content migration or WCAG compliance claim.
sections.changelog: Creates standard editable ACF field groups automatically for installed Page, Article, WooCommerce product and AWSM Team content types. Adds GRID-Arendal → Field groups with native field-design links, preserving existing customisation and intentional deletions. Workspace menu links follow native page/editor permissions; system-page exclusions and private response headers protect editorial screens. No new user permissions are granted.
